description: No changed_files at all — should short-circuit cleanly, not error.

Adding a copyleft-licensed dependency to an MIT project — tests license-conflict detection.
Malformed PRDiffInput missing required fields — tests input validation guardrail at the schema level, before any agent runs.
LICENSE file itself changed (MIT to GPL text swap).
Lockfile integrity hash changed with no real version change — tests Triage precision on ambiguous input.
Two packages changed in the same PR — tests parallel Research Agent calls.
Only application code changed, no manifest files — should short-circuit with zero LLM calls.
PR repo itself doesn't exist on GitHub — tests honest refusal on tool failure rather than fabrication.
Package doesn't exist on npm, but the PR's own repo is real — tests partial-result isolation, not total failure.
One package added, a different one removed, in the same diff.
Real, actively-maintained package (express) minor version bump — expect lower risk.
Version DECREASED rather than increased — edge case for extraction and reasoning.
Real package (lodash) with well-known unpatched vulnerabilities, version bump.
Manifest file changed but only whitespace/formatting, no real dependency change.
